content:
https://lean.commutator.io/

Hi community, using Claude Code, I proved all the theorems from secondary school "collège" and "lycée" and provided a web interface for visualizing the syntax, because these simple theorems are the most basic examples to understand LEAN for a developer.

Then, using a Claude skill, I tried to write back a textbook in natural language starting from the lean files, and without inventing too much. For the moment the book feels a bit dry, it only has a skeleton. I plan to solve the French exams in Lean and include more exercices and let Claude write the transitions in the text.

Lastly, with the help of Claude Code I wrote a web interface using React and published it to GitHub Pages. It has LEAN code review pane, and LaTeX renderer, and a small PDF pipeline.

GitHub repo and source code are available.
I am currently a data/AI engineer with a STEM background.


Everything took about a full day to do. I hope you like it.
